Lemma
[The Pullback of a Smooth Field of Forms is Smooth]

↗ def:pullback-form-of-family ↗ lem:bilinear-comp-of-family-smooth

If $F$ and the field $b$ are smooth, then $F^*b$ is a smooth field of bilinear forms on $TM$.
Proof

↗ def:pullback-form-of-family ↗ lem:bilinear-comp-of-family-smooth \sketch Apply Lemma 17 pointwise to $A_p=dF_p$, whose tangent-coordinate representation varies smoothly.

□
